```{r}
pgcd <- function(a, b) {
  a <- abs(a)
  b <- abs(b)
  while (b != 0) {
    temp <- b
    b <- a %% b
    a <- temp
  }
  return(a)
}

# Construction de la grille 

construire_grille_multi <- function(trajectoires, digits = 2) {
  liste_temps <- lapply(trajectoires, function(tr) tr$t)
  all_t <- sort(unique(round(unlist(liste_temps), digits)))
  if (length(all_t) < 2) {
    stop("Au moins deux instants distincts sont nécessaires.")
  }
  facteur <- 10^digits
  all_t_int <- round(all_t * facteur)
  diff_int <- diff(all_t_int)
  if (length(diff_int) == 0) {
    stop("Impossible de construire la grille.")
  }
  
  d <- Reduce(pgcd, diff_int)
  pas <- d / facteur
  t_max <- max(all_t)
  t_fine <- seq(from = 0,to = t_max,by = pas)
  
  return(list(
    t_fine = t_fine,
    pas = pas,
    n_fine = length(t_fine)
  ))
}
```

# Pont gamma séquentielle 

```{r}
pont_gamma_sequentiel_multi <- function(trajectoires, a, t_fine) {
  pas <- diff(t_fine)[1]
  tol <- 1e-10
  res <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(trajectoires)) {
    tr <- trajectoires[[i]]
    t_obs <- tr$t
    X_obs <- tr$X
    
    idx_max <- max(which(t_fine <= max(t_obs) + tol))
    t_fine_i <- t_fine[1:idx_max]
    K <- length(t_fine_i)
    if (K < 2) next
    
    X_fine <- rep(NA_real_, K)
    X_fine[1] <- X_obs[1]
    j_obs <- 1
    
    for (k in 2:K) {
      t_cible <- t_fine_i[k]
      
      while (j_obs < length(t_obs) && t_cible > t_obs[j_obs + 1] + tol) {
        j_obs <- j_obs + 1
      }
      
      if (j_obs < length(t_obs) && abs(t_cible - t_obs[j_obs + 1]) <= tol) {
        j_obs <- j_obs + 1
        X_fine[k] <- X_obs[j_obs]
        next
      }
      
      if (j_obs == length(t_obs)) {
        X_fine[k] <- X_obs[j_obs]
        next
      }
      
      t_sup <- t_obs[j_obs + 1]
      x_sup <- X_obs[j_obs + 1]
      
      delta1 <- pas                
      delta2 <- t_sup - t_cible      
      
      alpha1 <- a * delta1
      alpha2 <- a * delta2
      
      B <- rbeta(1, alpha1, alpha2)
      X_fine[k] <- X_fine[k - 1] + B * (x_sup - X_fine[k - 1])
    }
    
    X_fine[K] <- X_obs[length(X_obs)]
    
    diff_X <- diff(X_fine)
    
    res[[i]] <- list(
      t_fine  = t_fine_i,
      X_fine  = X_fine,
      diff_X  = diff_X
    )
  }
  return(res)
}
```


# Simulation d'un HGP

```{r}

set.seed(73)
simuler_gamma <- function(a, b, temps_obs) {
  delta_t <- diff(c(0, temps_obs))
  delta_X <- rgamma(length(delta_t), shape = a * delta_t, scale = 1/b)
  X <- cumsum(c(0, delta_X))
  list(t = c(0, temps_obs), X = X)
}
```

# Estimation des paramètres

```{r}
estimer_multi <- function(trajectoires) {
  
  all_dt <- numeric()
  all_dx <- numeric()
  
  for (i in seq_along(trajectoires)) {
    
    all_dt <- c(
      all_dt,
      diff(trajectoires[[i]]$t)
    )
    
    all_dx <- c(
      all_dx,
      diff(trajectoires[[i]]$X)
    )
  }
  
  mu_hat <- sum(all_dx) / sum(all_dt)
  
  denom <- sum(all_dt) -
    sum(all_dt^2) / sum(all_dt)
  
  nu_hat <- sum(
    (all_dx - mu_hat * all_dt)^2
  ) / denom
  
  a_hat <- mu_hat^2 / nu_hat
  
  return(a_hat)
}

```

# Application 1

```{r}
set.seed(46)

t_obs1 <- c(1.1, 3.5, 4, 5,7, 10, 12)
t_obs2 <- c(1, 2, 3, 5.1)

traj1 <- simuler_gamma(
  a = 2,
  b = 0.5,
  temps_obs = t_obs1
)

traj2 <- simuler_gamma(
  a = 2,
  b = 0.5,
  temps_obs = t_obs2
)

trajectoires <- list(
  traj1,
  traj2
)
```


```{r}
grille <- construire_grille_multi(
  trajectoires,
  digits = 2
)

t_fine <- grille$t_fine
```


```{r}
a_hat <- estimer_multi(trajectoires)

a_hat
```


```{r}
set.seed(46)

res <- pont_gamma_sequentiel_multi(
  trajectoires = trajectoires,
  a = 2,
  t_fine = t_fine
)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Points observés
df_obs <- data.frame(
  temps       = trajectoires[[1]]$t,
  degradation = trajectoires[[1]]$X,
  type        = "Observé"
)

# Points interpolés 
df_sim <- data.frame(
  temps       = res[[1]]$t_fine,
  degradation = res[[1]]$X_fine,
  type        = "Pont gamma"
)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data  = df_sim, aes(x = temps, y = degradation),
            color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data  = df_sim, aes(x = temps, y = degradation),
             color = "steelblue", shape = 16, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data  = df_obs, aes(x = temps, y = degradation),
             color = "red", shape = 16, size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Pont gamma séquentiel — Trajectoire 1",
    x     = "Temps",
    y     = "Dégradation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Nombre de points ajoutés 

```{r}
n_obs <- length(trajectoires[[1]]$t)

n_total <- length(res[[1]]$t_fine)

n_pseudo <- n_total - n_obs

cat("Observations :", n_obs, "\n")
cat("Total après pont gamma :", n_total, "\n")
cat("Pseudo-observations :", n_pseudo, "\n")
```
# Test d'adéquation 

```{r}
set.seed(47)
dx <- unlist(lapply(res, function(x) x$diff_X))

library(gofgamma)

# Test de Henze
test_henze <- test.HME1(dx, a = 1, boot = 200, alpha = 0.05)
print(test_henze)
```


```{r}
library(goft)
test_villa <- gamma_test(dx)
print(test_villa)

```



# Autres plans d'échantillonnage 

## Application 1: Fréquence croissante

```{r}
times_fonction <- function(tmax = 100, xmax = 10, n = 10) {
  f1 <- function(x) tmax * log(x + 1) / log(xmax + 1)
  x.pts <- seq(0, xmax, length.out = n + 1)
  tps <- f1(x.pts)
  round(tps, digits = 0)
}
```


```{r}

t1 <- times_fonction(n = 10)   
t2 <- times_fonction(n = 5)    

par(mfrow = c(2, 1))
plot(t1, rep(1, length(t1)), pch = 19, main = "t1", xlab = "t ", ylab = "")
plot(t2, rep(1, length(t2)), pch = 19, main = "t2", xlab = "t ", ylab = "")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```


```{r}
simuler_gamma <- function(a, b, temps_obs) {
  delta_t <- diff(temps_obs)
  delta_X <- rgamma(length(delta_t), shape = a * delta_t, scale = 1/b)
  X <- c(0, cumsum(delta_X))   
  list(t = temps_obs, X = X)
}
```


```{r}
set.seed(46)
traj1 <- simuler_gamma(a = 2, b = 0.5, temps_obs = t1)
traj2 <- simuler_gamma(a = 2,b = 0.5,temps_obs = t2)

traj
```

## Application 2: Fréquence décroissante


```{r}
times_fonction2<- function(tmax = 100, xmax = 10, n = 10) {
  f3 <- function(x) tmax * x^2 / (xmax^2)
  x.pts <- seq(0, xmax, length.out = n + 1)
  tps <- f3(x.pts)
  round(tps, digits = 0)          
}
```


```{r}
t3 <- times_fonction2(n = 10)   
t4 <- times_fonction2(n = 5)
```


```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 1))
plot(t3, rep(1, length(t1)), pch = 19, main = "t3", xlab = "t", ylab = "")
plot(t4, rep(1, length(t2)), pch = 19, main = "t4",  xlab = "t", ylab = "")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```


```{r}
simuler_gamma <- function(a, b, temps_obs) {
  delta_t <- diff(temps_obs)
  delta_X <- rgamma(length(delta_t), shape = a * delta_t, scale = 1/b)
  X <- c(0, cumsum(delta_X))   
  list(t = temps_obs, X = X)
}
```


```{r}
set.seed(46)
traj1 <- simuler_gamma(a = 2, b = 0.5, temps_obs = t3)
traj2 <- simuler_gamma(a = 2, b = 0.5, temps_obs = t4)
traj <- list(traj1, traj2)

grille <- construire_grille_multi(traj, digits = 2)
```


